label: input token o during copy phase (and at t=0)
explanation: Fires when the input token is the letter o being fed back during the copy phase (every copy-phase o fires, about 94% of activation mass), and weakly (~0.24 of max) when o is the very first original token (t=0). Does not fire on o at later original-phase positions (t>=1, apart from a small weaker tail at t=1), never at the delimiter, and almost never on other tokens (faint tail on z, r, g at ~0.1 of max). Magnitude: copy-phase o is near max (~0.7-1.0). An o directly following another o in the copy phase is somewhat weaker (~0.8-0.9). Lowest activations are the t=0 original-phase o and the stray non-o tokens.

issues: Minor: the misses are about 8% of active steps by count (test recall 0.916) but only 1.8% of activation mass. They are weak tails: original-phase o at t=1 (fires 23% of the time, about 0.10 to 0.22 of max), and copy-phase z, r and d at about 0.1. No strong systematic class.

Checked claims on the test split. Predicate false positives: 0, so every copy-phase o and every t=0 o fires. in_tok==o & t==0 alone has precision 1.0 and mass recall 0.053, consistent with weak firing at about 0.22. o at original-phase t>=2 has precision 0.0099, so it is essentially silent. Non-o tokens hold 0.85% of the mass, and the delimiter has 0 active steps.
